RESULTS.TITLE: Results
RESULTS.DESCRIPTION: This summary provides an overview of participants' performance in the tournament. The table includes ranking, successful predictions in different bet categories, and total payout.

MY_TOURNAMENTS.TITLE: My Tournaments
MY_TOURNAMENTS.DESCRIPTION: View and manage tournaments you are participating in. Accept invitations or proceed with active tournaments.

CUSTOM_TOURNAMENTS.TITLE: Manage Tournaments
CUSTOM_TOURNAMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Manage your custom tournaments. Use the edit, toggle, or delete actions for each tournament below.

PREDEFINED_TOURNAMENTS.TITLE: Manage Tournaments
PREDEFINED_TOURNAMENTS.DESCRIPTION: Manage your tournaments. Use the edit, toggle, or delete actions for each tournament below.

STAGE_USERS_MANAGEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Manage tournament users. Invitations are sent to users without accounts, they must sign up and accept to join.

STAGE_TEAMS_MANAGEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Edit the teams participating in the tournament. Scroll down to the bottom of the list to add a new team. Click the delete button to remove a team from the list.

STAGE_SUMMARY.DESCRIPTION1: Review the selected teams and matches before finalizing the tournament. Below, you can see the tournament name, teams participating, and the scheduled matches with corresponding odds.
STAGE_SUMMARY.DESCRIPTION2: If you need to make changes, go back to the previous steps. Once confirmed, click the Submit button to save the tournament.

STAGE_STAGES_MANAGEMENT.DESCRIPTION: Edit the stages for the tournament. Scroll down to the bottom of the list to add a new stage. Click the delete button to remove a stage.

STAGE_SETTINGS.DESCRIPTION: Configure additional tournament settings, including exact result bonuses, qualification bet rules, and penalties.
STAGE_SETTINGS.EXACT_RESULT_BONUS_INFO: If enabled, users get bonus points for exact match results.
STAGE_SETTINGS.WHO_QUALIFIES_BETS_INFO: Allows betting on which team qualifies in knockout rounds.
STAGE_SETTINGS.BETS_WITH_BOOSTER_INFO: Users can increase base odds using additional booster points.
STAGE_SETTINGS.PENALTY_INFO: If enabled, missing bets will incur a penalty.

STAGE_MATCHES_MANAGEMENT.DESCRIPTION: View and modify tournament matches. Click Edit to change match details, or Delete to remove a match. To add a new match, click Add New Match below.

STAGE_INPUT_TYPE.END_DATE_INFO: If an end date is provided, the tournament will automatically close on that date.
STAGE_INPUT_TYPE.DESCRIPTION: Manage tournaments by creating new ones or updating existing ones, with options to customize teams, games, and details.
STAGE_INPUT_TYPE.DETAILS: Set basic details, import data from file or templates, and configure match handling.
STAGE_INPUT_TYPE.MANUAL_DESC: Admin manually adds or updates matches.
STAGE_INPUT_TYPE.SEMI_DESC: Admin triggers updates from predefined tournaments.
STAGE_INPUT_TYPE.AUTO_DESC: Matches update automatically based on predefined tournaments.
STAGE_INPUT_TYPE.IMPORT_EXCEL: Import data from an Excel file
STAGE_INPUT_TYPE.IMPORT_TEMPLATE: Use a predefined tournament as a template
STAGE_INPUT_TYPE.CLEAR_FORM: Clear all form data and start from scratch
STAGE_INPUT_TYPE.HOME_ADVANTAGE_DESC: If enabled, odds will include the home advantage based on teams' ELO rankings.
